name: Bahugata
meaning_en: Name of son of Sudyu and father of Samyāti.

name: Bahugava
meaning_en: Name of a son of Sudyu and father of Samyāti.

name: Bahugavi
meaning_en: Name of a son of Dhundhu and father of Sañjāti.

name: Bahuli
meaning_en: Name of a son of Viśvā-mitra.

name: Bahuvrikta
meaning_en: Name of a descendant of Atri (author of ; 72).

name: Bahvashva
meaning_en: Name of a son of Mudgala.

name: Bahyaka
meaning_en: Name of a son of Bhajamāna, married the two sisters who were the daughters of Sṛñjaya and brought forth a number of sons.

name: Baijaladeva
meaning_en: Name of a prince and author, (cf. bIjala under bIja).

name: Bailva
meaning_en: Name of a man g. aSvAdi.

name: Bajabahadurachandra
meaning_en: Name of a son of Nīla-candra and patron of Anantadeva, (cf. bAhAdura).

name: Baka
meaning_en: Name of an Asura; a son of Andhaka and brother of Āḍi; friend of Kaṃsa; seized Kṛṣṇa in the guise of a crane; was torn to death.

name: Bakanakha
meaning_en: Name of a son of Viśvā-mitra.

name: Balabandhu
meaning_en: Name of a son of Manu Raivata.

name: Balagopalatirtha
meaning_en: Name of the teacher of Dhana-pati.

name: Balaka
meaning_en: Name of a pupil of Śāka- pūrṇi.

name: Balakashva
meaning_en: Name of a descendant of Jahnu.

name: Balakin
meaning_en: Name of a son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra.

name: Balambhatta
meaning_en: Name of sev. men and authors.

name: Balamdhana
meaning_en: Name of a son of Nābhāga and father of Vatsa- prītī.

name: Balashastrin
meaning_en: Name of a grammarian and of a living writer.

name: Balashva
meaning_en: Name of a king (called also Karaṃ-dhama).

name: Balasthala
meaning_en: Name of a son of Parijātra, (v.l. balaH sTalaH).

name: Balavardhana
meaning_en: Name of a son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra.

name: Balavrata
meaning_en: Name of the Buddhist saint Mañjuśrī.

name: Baleya
meaning_en: Name of the Kṣetraja sons of Bali through the sage Dīrghatamas.

name: Bali
meaning_en: Name of a man (various reading for bala-bhadra).

name: Balibahu
meaning_en: Name of a son of Jāmbavatī.

name: Balika
meaning_en: Name of a son of Maya.

name: Balivardin
meaning_en: Name of a man g. SuBrAdi- ( baliv˚).

name: Balivindhya
meaning_en: Name of a son of Manu Raivata.

name: Balvala
meaning_en: Name of a Daitya, the son of Ilvala.

name: Bambhari
meaning_en: Name of one of the 7 tutelary deities of the Soma plant.

name: Bana
meaning_en: Name of a son of Danu and Mahāsena.

name: Bandhana
meaning_en: Name of the third chapter of the first part of the Rasendra-kalpa-druma, a medical work by Rāma-kṛṣṇa.

name: Bandhu
meaning_en: Name of the son of Vegavat and father of Tṛṇa- bindu.

name: Bandhuman
meaning_en: Name of a son of Kevala and father of Vegavat.

name: Bapubhatta
meaning_en: Name of an author (also called Ananta-bhaṭṭa).

name: Barhaketu
meaning_en: Name of a son of Sagara.

name: Barhana
meaning_en: Name of a prince, a son of Nikumbha.

name: Barhanashva
meaning_en: Name of a prince (son of Nikumbha).

name: Barhi
meaning_en: Name of a descendant of Aṅgiras.

name: Barhiketu
meaning_en: Name of a son of Sagara.

name: Barku
meaning_en: Name of a man with the patr. Vārṣṇa.

name: Baru
meaning_en: Name of a descendant of Aṅgiras (author of ).

name: Bashkala
meaning_en: Name of a teacher (a pupil of Paila).

name: Bashkali
meaning_en: Name of a son of Bāṣkala; author of the Vālakhilya.

name: Batukanatha
meaning_en: Name of a pupil of Śaṃkarācārya.

name: Bavashastrin
meaning_en: Name of the author of the Svarodaya-vivaraṇa, q.

name: Bayabhatta
meaning_en: Name of a son of Kṛṣṇa and father of Advaita.

name: Bhadatta
meaning_en: Name of an astronomer, (v.l. badanta, q.v.).

name: Bhadita
meaning_en: Name of a man g. gargAdi.

name: Bhadra
meaning_en: Name of a son of Dakṣiṇā and a Tuṣita God.

name: Bhadrabahu
meaning_en: Name of a son of Śaṭha, of the Rohiṇī family,.

name: Bhadracharu
meaning_en: Name of a son of Kṛṣṇa.

name: Bhadrachitra
meaning_en: Name of a son of Jāmbavatī and Kṛṣṇa.

name: Bhadradeha
meaning_en: Name of a son of Vasu-deva.

name: Bhadradeva
meaning_en: Name of a son of Devakī and Vasudeva, killed by Kaṃsa.

name: Bhadragupti
meaning_en: Name of a son of Śaṭha, of the Rohiṇī family.

name: Bhadraka
meaning_en: Name of a son of Śibi.

name: Bhadrakalpa
meaning_en: Name of a son of Śaṭha, of the Rohiṇī family.

name: Bhadrakara
meaning_en: Name of a son of Kṛṣṇa.

name: Bhadrama
meaning_en: Name of a son of Kali and a cannibal.

name: Bhadrasena
meaning_en: Name of a man with the patr. Ājātaśatrava.

name: Bhadrashakha
meaning_en: Name of a form of Skanda.

name: Bhadrashrava
meaning_en: Name of a son of Dharma after whom came the continent of Bhadrāśva; a devout worshipper of Hayagrīva.

name: Bhadrashravas
meaning_en: Name of a son of Dharma.

name: Bhadrashva
meaning_en: Name of a son of Vasu-deva and Rohiṇī.

name: Bhadravaha
meaning_en: Name of : a son of Vasudeva and Pauravī.

name: Bhadravideha
meaning_en: Name of a son of Devakī and Vasudeva; killed by Kaṃsa.

name: Bhadravinda
meaning_en: Name of a son of Kṛṣṇa.

name: Bhadravindra
meaning_en: Name of a son of Jāmbavatī.

name: Bhadravishtha
meaning_en: Name of a son of Śaṭha and of the Rohiṇī family.

name: Bhadreshvara
meaning_en: Name of various statues and Liṅgas of Śiva (cf. prec.).

name: Bhadrika
meaning_en: Name of a prince of the Śākyas, (v.l. Badraka).

name: Bhaga
meaning_en: Name of a prince of Prāg-jyotiṣa.

name: Bhagadatta
meaning_en: Name of a King of the Kinnaras.

name: Bhaganya
meaning_en: Name of a Rājarṣi, becoming a Brāhmaṇa.

name: Bhagavadbhatta
meaning_en: Name of the author of a Comm. on the Rasa-taraṃgiṇī.

name: Bhagavadbhavaka
meaning_en: Name of the author of a Comm. on.

name: Bhagavaddasa
meaning_en: Name of the author of a Comm. on.

name: Bhagavan
meaning_en: Name of the principal and eternal god; the sum and substance of the three Vedas; Bha.

name: Bhagavanta
meaning_en: Name of the author of the Mukunda-vilāsa.

name: Bhagavantadeva
meaning_en: Name of a prince (king of Bhareha, son of Sāhi-deva and a patron of Nīlakaṇṭha cf. next).

name: Bhagavata
meaning_en: Name of a son of Vajramitra and father of Deva- bhūti.

name: Bhagavitti
meaning_en: Name of a son of Kuthumi.

name: Bhairava
meaning_en: Name of a form of Śiva (cf. ).

name: Bhairavasimha
meaning_en: Name of a son of Narasiṃha and patron of Ruci-pati.

name: Bhairika
meaning_en: Name of a son of Kṛṣṇa by Satyabhāmā.

name: Bhajamana
meaning_en: Name of a son of Sātvata.

name: Bhajina
meaning_en: Name of : a son of Sātvata and Kauśalyā.

name: Bhalandana
meaning_en: Name of a man (father of Vatsa-prī or Vatsa-prīti).

name: Bhallabha
meaning_en: Name of a son of Udaksena.

name: Bhallada
meaning_en: Name of a king, = bhallāṭa above.

name: Bhamaha
meaning_en: Name of the author of the Alaṃkāra-śāstra and of the Prākṛta-manoramā (Comm. on the Prākṛta-prakāśa).

name: Bhaminivilasa
meaning_en: Name of a poem by Jagannātha Paṇḍita-rāja (the 1st ch. contains allegorical precepts, the 2nd amatory subjects, the 3rd an elegy on a wife's death, the 4th teaches that consolation is only attainable through worshipping Kṛṣṇa).

name: Bhanandana
meaning_en: Name of a man, (prob. w.r. for Balandana).

name: Bhanava
meaning_en: Name of son of Bhānu and Dharma.

name: Bhandi
meaning_en: Name of a minister of Śrī-harṣa.

name: Bhandijangha
meaning_en: Name of a man Sch. on.

name: Bhandiratha
meaning_en: Name of a man g. tika-kitavAdi.

name: Bhandita
meaning_en: Name of a man g. gargAdi.

name: Bhanga
meaning_en: Name of a son of A-vikṣit.

name: Bhangakara
meaning_en: Name of two men (sons of Avikṣit and Sattrā-jit).

name: Bhangakari
meaning_en: Name of an Asura of Bali.

name: Bhangileya
meaning_en: Name of a man (or mfn. ‘coming from Bhāṅgila’ ?).

name: Bhanuman
meaning_en: Name of the son of Bṛhadaśva and father of Pratīkāśva.

name: Bhanumitra
meaning_en: Name of a prince (son of Candra-giri), (cf. next).

name: Bhanuratha
meaning_en: Name of a prince (son of Candra-giri), (cf. prec.).

name: Bhanushchandra
meaning_en: Name of a son of Candragiri.

name: Bhappata
meaning_en: Name of a man (who built a temple named after him BappaweSvara).

name: Bharama
meaning_en: Name of a man g. SuBrAdi.

name: Bharanya
meaning_en: Name of a son of Muni, (v.l. AraRya).

name: Bharatitirtha
meaning_en: Name of an author (the Guru of Sāyaṇa), (˚TIya n. his wk.).

name: Bharavi
meaning_en: Name of the author of the Kirātārjunīya (first mentioned in an of 634 A.D.).

name: Bharchhu
meaning_en: Name of a poet, (prob. w.r. for Barvu).

name: Bharmyashva
meaning_en: Name of a prince (father of Mudgala), (cf. hary-aSva and BArmyaSva).

name: Bhartrihari
meaning_en: Name of a well-known poet and grammarian (of the 7th century A.D.; author of 300 moral, political, and religious maxims comprised in 3 Śatakas, and of the Vākyapadīya and other gram. works., and according to some also of the Bhaṭṭi-kāvya).

name: Bharu
meaning_en: Name of a son of Kṛṣṇa.

name: Bharuchi
meaning_en: Name of an author on Dharma and Vedānta.

name: Bharuka
meaning_en: Name of a prince, (v.l. kuruka, or ruruka).

name: Bhashchu
meaning_en: Name of a poet, (prob. w.r. for Barvu).

name: Bhashyakara
meaning_en: Name of various commentators (of Patañjali, Śaṃkarācārya, a poet ), , Vārtt., , Sch.

name: Bhaskaracharya
meaning_en: Name of various authors (esp. of a celebrated astronomer who lived in the 12th century and wrote the Siddhānta-śiromaṇi ).

name: Bhattanarayana
meaning_en: Name of the author of the Veṇī-saṃhāra and of other writers.

name: Bhattanayaka
meaning_en: Name of a poet and a rhetorician.

name: Bhatti
meaning_en: Name of a poet (also called Bhartṛsvāmin or -hari, or Bhaṭṭa-svāmin or Svāmi-bhaṭṭa).

name: Bhattika
meaning_en: Name of the mythical progenitor of copyists (son of Citra-gupta and grandson of Brahmā).

name: Bhattoji
meaning_en: Name of a grammarian (son of Lakṣmī-dhara, author of the Siddhānta-kaumudī and other works.).

name: Bhaulacharya
meaning_en: Name of an author (also written BAqalAcArya).

name: Bhauma
meaning_en: Name of a name of the Asura, Naraka (s.

name: Bhaumari
meaning_en: Name of a son of Satyabhāmā.

name: Bhauvana
meaning_en: Name of a son of Manthu and Satyā.

name: Bhavabhuti
meaning_en: Name of a celebrated poet (who lived in the 8th century A.D., author of the 3 dramas Mālatīmādhava, Mahā-vīra-carita or Vīra-carita, and Uttararāma-carita; cf. ).

name: Bhavakhami
meaning_en: Name of a man, (prob. w.r. for -svAmin, q.v.).

name: Bhavanatha
meaning_en: Name of an author (also with Wakkura, mahA-mahopADyAya and miSra).

name: Bhavanidasa
meaning_en: Name of a king (also with cakra-vartin).

name: Bhayamana
meaning_en: Name of a man, ; 17 (; accord, to, the author of ).

name: Bhayasakha
meaning_en: Name of a son of Vasudeva and Sahadevā.

name: Bheri
meaning_en: Name of a poet, (perhaps for bherī-jhāṅ-kāra.) —Bherī-svana-mahā-svanā, f., N.

name: Bhikshachara
meaning_en: Name of a son of Bhoja (also called, Bikzu).

name: Bhimakarma
meaning_en: Name of a minister of Bhaṇḍa who advised him to fight Indra.

name: Bhimaparakrama
meaning_en: Name of a man, of Śiva.

name: Bhimasena
meaning_en: Name of a son of Parīkṣit.

name: Bhishagdvaitarata
meaning_en: Name of a son of Hṛdika.

name: Bhishaja
meaning_en: Name of a man g. gargAdi ().

name: Bhishak
meaning_en: Name of a son of Hṛdika.

name: Bhishana
meaning_en: Name of a Vānara born of Pulaha.

name: Bhishidasa
meaning_en: Name of the patron of Nārāyaṇa (author of a Comm. on ).

name: Bhishnaja
meaning_en: Name of a man g. gargAdi (cf. Bizaja).

name: Bhogi
meaning_en: Name of son of Śeṣa, the Nāga king.

name: Bhoj
meaning_en: Generous, enjoyer; also the famed king Bhoja of Malwa.

name: Bhojadeva
meaning_en: Name of a celebrated king of Dhārā (who was a great patron of learning at the beginning of the 11th century, and is the reputed author of sev. works., esp. of a Comm. on the Yoga-sūtras, cf. ; 532 ).

name: Bhojanarendra
meaning_en: Name of Bhoja-deva, king of Dhārā.

name: Bhojaprabandha
meaning_en: Name of wk. (celebrating the deeds of king Bhoja).

name: Bhojaprabandhasara
meaning_en: Name of wk. (celebrating the deeds of king Bhoja).

name: Bhrajishtha
meaning_en: Name of a son of Ghṛta-pṛṣṭha.

name: Bhrajita
meaning_en: Name of a gaṇa of the epoch of Bhautya Manu.

name: Bhrashtraki
meaning_en: Name of a man, (also read bhrāṣṭra-kṛt.).

name: Bhrigu
meaning_en: Name of the father of Atharvaṇa Agni.

name: Bhrigubhumi
meaning_en: Name of a son of Aṅgiras (belonging to the family of the Bhṛgus, cf. Barga-BUmi, BArga-BUmi).

name: Bhrigurakshasa
meaning_en: Name of a Ṛṣi (said to have sacrificed men and cows).

name: Bhrikuti
meaning_en: Name of the servant of the twentieth Arhat of the present Ava-sarpiṇī.

name: Bhringariti
meaning_en: Name of one of Śiva's attendants (cf. BfNgin, BfNgiriwa ).

name: Bhringi
meaning_en: Name of one of Śiva's attendants (cf. next).

name: Bhudda
meaning_en: Name of a poet (contemporary of Maṅkha).

name: Bhuja
meaning_en: Name of an author, (also called bhuja-bala-bhīma.) —Bhuja- madhya, am, n.

name: Bhujyu
meaning_en: Name of a son of Tugra saved from shipwreck by the Aśvins.

name: Bhukashyapa
meaning_en: Name of Vasu-deva (the father of Kṛṣṇa).

name: Bhumanandasarasvati
meaning_en: Name of the teacher of Advaitānanda.

name: Bhumanyu
meaning_en: Name of a son of Bharata.

name: Bhumi
meaning_en: Name of a son or grandson of Yuyudhāna and father of Yugaṃdhara.

name: Bhumimitra
meaning_en: Name of a son of Vindhyasena, ruled for 14 years.
